import json,collections
p='answers.jsonl'
a=[json.loads(s) for s in open(p)]
a[11]['slots']['6']='ь'
for n in [8,24]: a[n-1]['pre1918']='no'
for n in [48,55]:
 for k in a[n-1]['confidence']: a[n-1]['confidence'][k]='high'
with open(p,'w') as f:
 for x in a:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
r=[json.loads(s) for s in open('items.jsonl')]
assert len(a)==len(r)==95
for x,y in zip(r,a):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 expected={str(k) for k in range(1,x['slots']+1)}
 assert set(y['slots'])==set(y['confidence'])==expected
 assert set(y['slots'].values()) <= {'ъ','ь','other','u'}
 assert set(y['confidence'].values()) <= {'high','low'}
 assert y['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
c=collections.Counter(v for x in a for v in x['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, slot coverage:',len(a),'items;',sum(c.values()),'slots')
print(dict(c))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(x['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for x in a))
